recipe.hypothesis: Three-finger tendon pinch with wider spread and larger palm gives adequate opening for irregular parts while keeping joint count low.
Four-finger even power grasp with longer fingers provides high force and redundancy for bulky components while respecting servo limits via reduced phalanges.
Opposed three-finger tendon pinch yields precise alignment for asymmetric parts while limiting servo usage.
Four-finger hook gripper swinging motion catches flanges and rims, improving hold on parts with overhangs.
Three-digit tentacle with increased palm radius and moderate curl bias wraps around cylindrical and hexagonal parts while avoiding narrow openings.

batches.analysis: First round: aim for versatile effectors using moderate grip forces (~10-20 N) and heights near mid-part. Vary finger count, actuation, and generator type to explore pinch vs power and hook/tentacle strategies while staying within validator limits.
